• What you hold: the offers you bought or were given, when they renew or end, and the price agreed.
  • Payments: the amount and date of each payment. Your card number is never stored here; the payment provider holds it.
  • Billing: when you first pay, the payment provider keeps a customer record with your email address, so your receipts and invoices stay together. We keep only its reference.
  • Checkouts you started, kept 30 days.
  • Your answers to reminders, and any scholarship or price reduction given to you.
  • Records of changes the site owner makes, which name the owner who made them (kept 2 years).
